title: Chapter 511
paragraphs: Chapter 511
Episode 141. Crash (4)

Luna's abdication of the throne, Jin's declaration as the new head of the family, and Joshua's fall. Among the particularly significant events of the current generation, this incident undoubtedly caused the biggest shock to the family.
No one expected Joshua to fall like this.
He had always been the next head of the family after Luna gave up the throne, and behind him was Rosa's strong support and favoritism.
But it was Rosa who personally brought down Joshua. And she did it in a malicious way that trampled on his pride and tarnished his honor in front of everyone.

"Ha, it's satisfying, but it's also unpleasant. He wasn't someone to go down so easily... Well, whatever my intentions were, in the end, it wasn't unreasonable to think of it as the price for hindering an important mission and losing two Black Knights."
Pong, gulp, gulp...

As Diffus filled his glass with alcohol and spoke, his eyes were dull. He had been looking forward to the day Joshua would fall since he was a child, but when he actually saw this kind of ending, he felt as if an unpleasant emptiness was flowing through his veins instead of blood.
Even by gulping down the poison-like alcohol that ordinary people couldn't even take a sip of, his bitter insides wouldn't be soothed.
It wasn't just hatred for Joshua, but also a sense of affection that he had harbored.

Diffus was tormented by the regret of not being able to deal with his archenemy with his own hands, and the sense of powerlessness from realizing that a single word from his mother was incomparably heavier than the authority and fighting spirit he had maintained as a higher-ranking knight.

Speaking of which, "Youngest, you went too far. If you knew he was a clone, you should have given me a hint, shouldn't you? No, it's not your fault... I'm the fool who didn't know all this time. I should have suspected something when you played with your wicked tongue in Sota Desert's hideout, saying we should kill him together."
"You've been talking to yourself and answering yourself. You're a real drunk, brother. If Lady Meri were here, she would have scolded you."
"She would have understood me. You try having your long-awaited prey snatched away and see if your insides turn upside down or not."
At that, Jin quietly wore a cold smile.
In his 28 years of previous life and 20 years of current life, a total of 48 years, Jin's greatest enemy changed twice.
In his previous life, his own family, Runcandel, was almost the greatest enemy, and in his current life, after going through various incidents, he ended up confronting Ziephel as a Runcandel.
However, an enemy and a nemesis are different concepts. The opponent who Jin personally harbored the greatest grudge against had never changed since he found out the inside story of the curse.
'Joshua Runcandel....'
So, Jin was also robbed of his prey, and there was no way his insides wouldn't rot. Rather, he was barely suppressing an even more empty feeling than Diffus.
The reason was none other than this.
"It doesn't seem like this will be the end."

"It might be less disgusting for you, but this time, it's definitely over. There's no way, but it's not something that can be resolved by Mother's forgiveness. After seeing him stutter and tremble earlier, who would follow Joshua again? It's an impossible thing even in other martial arts schools, let alone Runcandel."
Jindo and Diphus took the offered drinks and downed about six shots in a row.
"Come to think of it, isn't it a bit strange?"
"What is?"

"If Mother had formally charged Joshua with a family trial and ordered the truth about the mission to be clarified, he might not have fallen so pathetically. Even if he had shared the information from the beginning, with Hedo as a variable, it might have been impossible to save both Black Knights."
The White Night Tower Keeper, Hedo.
After reporting their mission, Jindo and Diphus had not yet heard any information about him from Rosa and the Council of Elders.
It was unknown whether Rosa and the council didn't know him or if there was another reason. They could only guess that the latter possibility was much more likely.

"If that had happened, Mother could have caused Nana's downfall instead. Joshua may be the highest authority, but we also have a responsibility as knights, and even though he's a clone, in the end, he sacrificed himself for the family, didn't he?"
"If we assume that, then Joshua could have strangely implicated you as a traitor for receiving help from Sandra Ziefl. There's also your relationship with Veradin Ziefl."

"I don't think Mother would have been unaware of something we could think of. No, she must have known. And her goal has always been to make Joshua the head of the family, but now she has made a completely opposite decision."

"Mother must have finally admitted it. That he isn't fit to be the head of the family. I don't know why she only realized it now. Damn it, he was so scared he even dragged knights into it, and then showed such a stupid side... If I were in that position, I would have cut his throat right there."
As Diphus nervously kept emptying his glass, Jindo wondered why Rosa had attacked Joshua instead of them.
The end.
Diphus' words were not wrong. Those who saw Joshua's pathetic appearance yesterday would never acknowledge or follow him again.
Suddenly.
A new assumption popped into Jindo's head.
"The prophet."
"What?"
"What if Joshua's mind was manipulated by the prophet's power and dark magic?"
"Do you think that's likely? Yesterday, Joshua's stuttering was the very essence of his childhood when he was trampled by his father and elder brother. It was his true nature."
"I know that. I don't really think the prophet would have manipulated Joshua's mind. But if Mother later claims that and restores Joshua's position... What do you think?"
Thunk, Diphus put down his glass.
The prophet, using an unknown power, provided crucial help in this mission, and had also been helping Joshua and the family's missions he was in charge of until now.
He also created Joshua's clone.
The true identity of the prophet has not yet been fully revealed, but everyone in Runcandel now knows of his existence and the deeds he has done.
Some will argue that the prophet should be driven out for breaking the law, some will say he is a necessary existence to confront the enemies, and some will remain neutral and silent.
However, they all have to admit one fact: Joshua's prophet possesses a nearly divine power.
"Alright, then what's the third thing? Even if killing the second-generation is secondary, what's the ultimate goal? How will the death of the second-generation benefit the family?"

"It feels like getting a test graded, second brother. What benefits the family? Cutting off the rotten chain of favoritism and purifying the family. Even if Joshua dies, the prophet will still be loyal to Mother, so we can decide what to do with his abilities then."
The conversation between Jindo and Diphus in the Sota Desert.
Not only Rosa but also Diphus believed that the prophet's power should be used for the family, to find the legacy of the first head of the family and to slaughter the enemies.
This belief was reinforced through the experiences and observations during this mission.

The flying fleet of over a hundred ships, Hedo, and the unidentified demons who had turned Black Knight Mon to ash. The power the enemies hid clearly exceeded the knights' imagination, even if only a part of it was revealed.

"Mother will never give up the prophet's power. Dethroning Joshua this time... it might even be a warning to the prophet. If the relationship between Mother and the prophet isn't as close as Joshua's, it's entirely possible."
"So you're saying, Mother plans to control the prophet, later blame everything on him, and restore Joshua's position?"

"Not only that, but by bringing down Joshua, Mother has reestablished your authority. The blemish from the Exile incident will disappear. Mother has shown the strength to personally break the second-generation, whom she supported so much. Regardless of the inside story, the family members will have no choice but to fear Mother even more."
"By maximizing your power and then pulling Joshua back to the ground, transferring all power to him... sins and justification will be borne by the prophet."
Silence enveloped them for a moment.
The two no longer filled their glasses.

"…That's not an impossible possibility. No, it's quite high. If the Joshua at the time of the restoration shows a much stronger appearance, so much so that everyone would think the previous shortcomings were due to the prophet's mind manipulation."
If at that time Joshua could receive power from Rosa to purge all those who harbor suspicions, and his own power would become the undisputed strongest knight.
Joshua's restoration was entirely possible.
"There's one more thing."
"More?"
"Do you know how the prophet creates Joshua's clones?"
-Do you know how that woman clones Joshua?
-I only know that it requires a lot of people.
-...What?

-It seems she uses the prisoners on death row in Hufester. When she sends them to the prophet, a new body is created... but she mostly used that body for handling people like me. Strengthening her potential contractors or suppressing them when they went berserk.
Jin killed Joshua's first clone in the Blue Bird Highway and heard from Yulian that the prophet uses humans as materials.

He was currently tracking related information after accidentally hearing about the strange executions happening at 'Ricarlton' from Emma. Right after the Black King incident ended, he sent Black Knight Docks there.
"Humans are used as materials. A large number of humans. It's information I got from capturing one of his direct hunting dogs during my time as a potential knight."
"Ha. If that's true, he should pay an even greater price for his sins…"

"But Joshua is already locked up in an underground prison. There's no way to dig deeper. At least not officially. Who would dare to claim that Joshua, whom Mother personally dethroned, should be trampled on more? I have witnesses, but I don't have solid evidence yet. I can't even claim it lightly."
Diphus felt a cold wind passing through his back.
His senses, dulled by alcohol, became sharply alert, and goosebumps rose on the back of his neck.
'If the youngest is right... Joshua's fall is just a successful strategy by Mother...!'
Of course, all of this was just speculation.
But as sons who knew the person called Rosa Runcandel, both of them... intuitively felt that the speculation was very close to the truth.
"So now is not the time to soothe our drunken stomachs with alcohol. The fight has only just begun."
